ubiquitousLanguage.definition: A named business metric tracked over time, such as Monthly Revenue or Active Customers. It is the aggregate root that groups time-series snapshots of the same measurement.
An immutable amount-and-currency pair representing a single monetary measurement. Used as the value type for RevenueSnapshot amounts.
usageExamples: RevenueSnapshot.amount: Decimal paired with RevenueSnapshot.currency: str

ubiquitousLanguage.definition: The contiguous time window covered by a snapshot, defined by a start date and end date (both inclusive). Represented as a DateRange value object.
A point-in-time revenue reading for a specific reporting period. Immutable once recorded. Belongs to a CompanyMetric of type REVENUE.
A point-in-time customer count reading capturing new customers acquired, churned customers lost, and the derived net change for a reporting period.
A triggered alert instance created when an AlertRule's threshold condition is crossed. Progresses through the ACTIVE -> ACKNOWLEDGED -> RESOLVED lifecycle.
The urgency classification of an alert: INFO (informational only), WARNING (action recommended), or CRITICAL (immediate action required).
The lifecycle state of a DashboardAlert: ACTIVE (newly triggered, not yet reviewed), ACKNOWLEDGED (seen by a staff user), or RESOLVED (closed).
A persistent configuration that defines the metric, threshold condition, and severity used to create DashboardAlerts when the condition is satisfied during scheduled evaluation.
The logical comparison applied during alert evaluation: the combination of a ThresholdOperator and a threshold_value that, when satisfied by a metric reading, triggers a DashboardAlert.
An enumeration of comparison operators used in AlertConditions: GT (greater than), LT (less than), GTE (greater than or equal), LTE (less than or equal), EQ (equal).
An immutable record of a staff-initiated state-changing operation, capturing who performed what action on which target and when. Never modified after creation.
An enumeration identifying the type of operation recorded in an AuditLogEntry (e.g., METRIC_CREATED, ALERT_ACKNOWLEDGED, IMPORT_COMPLETED).
An ordered sequence of snapshot values for a single CompanyMetric over a DateRange, used as input to aggregation computations such as rolling averages and period deltas.
An immutable value object representing a contiguous interval between a start_date and end_date (both inclusive). Used to scope snapshot queries and aggregation windows.
An immutable value object representing the absolute and percentage change between a current metric value and a prior metric value. Used for KPI delta indicators on the dashboard.
The mean of a CompanyMetric's snapshot values within a sliding window of a specified number of days, computed by MetricAggregationService and returned as a Decimal.
usageExamples: Decimal result representing the rolling mean

ubiquitousLanguage.definition: A background task that reads a CSV file and persists rows as CompanyMetric snapshots. Transitions through PENDING -> PROCESSING -> COMPLETE | FAILED states.
usageExamples: imports.py use case dispatched via Django-Q2

ubiquitousLanguage.definition: The lifecycle state of an ImportJob: PENDING (queued but not yet started), PROCESSING (actively executing), COMPLETE (all rows persisted successfully), FAILED (terminated with a fatal error).
A single parsed line from an imported CSV file representing one data point that maps to a snapshot value for a CompanyMetric.
An enumeration classifying what a CompanyMetric measures: REVENUE (monetary amounts), CUSTOMER_GROWTH (customer count changes), or CUSTOM (any other measurement).
The activation state of an AlertRule: ACTIVE (included in scheduled evaluation runs), PAUSED (evaluation suspended and no new DashboardAlerts will be created).

entities.name: CompanyMetric
invariants: name must not be blank
metric_type must be a valid MetricType value
All snapshots within the MetricAggregate boundary must be consistent with this metric's metric_type

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this metric.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name (e.g., Monthly Revenue).

attributes.name: metric_type
attributes.description: Classifies what this metric measures: REVENUE, CUSTOMER_GROWTH, or CUSTOM.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional long-form description of the metric.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when this metric was first created.

entities.name: RevenueSnapshot
invariants: metric_id must reference a CompanyMetric with metric_type REVENUE
amount must be >= 0
period_end must be >= period_start
currency must be a 3-letter ISO 4217 alphabetic code

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this snapshot.

attributes.name: metric_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent CompanyMetric by identity.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Revenue amount for the reporting period.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: 3-letter ISO 4217 currency code (defaults to USD).

attributes.name: period_start
attributes.description: First day of the reporting period (inclusive).

attributes.name: period_end
attributes.description: Last day of the reporting period (inclusive).

attributes.name: recorded_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was persisted.

entities.name: CustomerGrowthSnapshot
invariants: metric_id must reference a CompanyMetric with metric_type CUSTOMER_GROWTH
new_customers must be >= 0
churned_customers must be >= 0
net_customers must equal new_customers - churned_customers at all times
period_end must be >= period_start

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this snapshot.

attributes.name: metric_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent CompanyMetric by identity.

attributes.name: new_customers
attributes.description: Number of customers acquired during the period.

attributes.name: churned_customers
attributes.description: Number of customers lost during the period.

attributes.name: net_customers
attributes.description: Derived: new_customers - churned_customers. Computed at construction and must remain consistent.

attributes.name: period_start
attributes.description: First day of the reporting period (inclusive).

attributes.name: period_end
attributes.description: Last day of the reporting period (inclusive).

attributes.name: recorded_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was persisted.

entities.name: DashboardAlert
invariants: resolved_at must be None unless status is RESOLVED
acknowledged_at must be None unless status is ACKNOWLEDGED or RESOLVED
acknowledged_by must be set (non-null) when status is ACKNOWLEDGED or RESOLVED
resolved_by must be set (non-null) when status is RESOLVED
An alert in RESOLVED status cannot be transitioned further

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this alert instance.

attributes.name: rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the AlertRule that created this alert by identity.

attributes.name: metric_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CompanyMetric whose value triggered this alert by identity.

attributes.name: triggered_value
attributes.description: The metric value that crossed the threshold at trigger time.

attributes.name: threshold_value
attributes.description: Snapshot of the threshold defined in the AlertRule at trigger time.

attributes.name: operator
attributes.description: Snapshot of the comparison operator from the AlertRule at trigger time.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Urgency classification copied from the AlertRule at trigger time.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this alert.

attributes.name: acknowledged_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when acknowledged; None if not yet acknowledged.

attributes.name: acknowledged_by
attributes.description: Actor who acknowledged this alert; None if not yet acknowledged.

attributes.name: resolved_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when resolved; None if not yet resolved.

attributes.name: resolved_by
attributes.description: Actor who resolved this alert; None if not yet resolved.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when this alert was first created.

entities.name: AlertRule
invariants: name must not be blank
metric_id must reference an existing CompanyMetric
threshold_value must be a finite Decimal
operator must be a valid ThresholdOperator value
An AlertRule in PAUSED status must not create new DashboardAlerts

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this rule.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable name for this rule.

attributes.name: metric_id
attributes.description: Reference to the CompanyMetric this rule evaluates by identity.

attributes.name: operator
attributes.description: Comparison operator used in the threshold condition.

attributes.name: threshold_value
attributes.description: The numeric threshold to compare against during evaluation.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Severity level assigned to any DashboardAlert created by this rule.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Activation state: ACTIVE or PAUSED.

attributes.name: last_evaluated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent evaluation run; None if never evaluated.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rule was first created.

entities.name: AuditLogEntry
invariants: created_at is set at construction and must never change
actor_id must be provided and non-null
action must be a valid AuditAction value
AuditLogEntry is write-once: no fields may be mutated after creation

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this audit record.

attributes.name: actor_id
attributes.description: Identity of the staff user who performed the recorded action.

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: Enumerated type of operation performed.

attributes.name: target_id
attributes.description: Identity of the affected domain object; None when the action has no single target.

attributes.name: target_type
attributes.description: Class name of the affected domain object (e.g., 'CompanyMetric').

attributes.name: detail
attributes.description: Optional free-text detail providing additional context about the operation.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Immutable timestamp set at construction. Never updated.

valueObjects.name: MetricValue
validationRules: currency must be a 3-letter ISO 4217 alphabetic code
currency defaults to 'USD' when not supplied
valueObjects.equalityBasis: All properties (amount and currency) must be equal

valueObjects.name: DateRange
valueObjects.equalityBasis: All properties (start_date and end_date) must be equal

valueObjects.name: PeriodDelta
validationRules: No construction-time numeric constraints; delta (current_value - prior_value) and percentage_change (None when prior_value is 0) are computed properties
valueObjects.equalityBasis: All properties (current_value and prior_value) must be equal

valueObjects.name: ThresholdOperator
valueObjects.equalityBasis: Enum identity: equal when the string value is the same

valueObjects.name: MetricType
valueObjects.equalityBasis: Enum identity: equal when the string value is the same

valueObjects.name: AlertSeverity
valueObjects.equalityBasis: Enum identity: equal when the string value is the same

valueObjects.name: AlertStatus
valueObjects.equalityBasis: Enum identity: equal when the string value is the same

valueObjects.name: AlertRuleStatus
valueObjects.equalityBasis: Enum identity: equal when the string value is the same

valueObjects.name: ImportStatus
valueObjects.equalityBasis: Enum identity: equal when the string value is the same

valueObjects.name: AuditAction
valueObjects.equalityBasis: Enum identity: equal when the string value is the same

aggregates.name: MetricAggregate
invariants: All snapshots within this boundary must have a metric_id matching the root CompanyMetric.id
All RevenueSnapshots may only belong to a CompanyMetric with metric_type REVENUE
All CustomerGrowthSnapshots may only belong to a CompanyMetric with metric_type CUSTOMER_GROWTH
Snapshots are created and retrieved only through the CompanyMetric root - never constructed directly by application code

aggregates.name: AlertAggregate
invariants: DashboardAlerts are only created by AlertRule.evaluate() - never constructed directly by application code
An AlertRule in PAUSED status must not create new DashboardAlerts
All DashboardAlerts within this boundary must have a rule_id matching the root AlertRule.id
severity, threshold_value, and operator on a DashboardAlert are snapshots taken from the AlertRule at trigger time and must not change thereafter

aggregates.name: AuditAggregate
invariants: AuditLogEntries are write-once: no field may be mutated after persist
AuditLogEntries are only appended by application use cases after a confirmed state-changing operation - domain entities never write audit entries directly
actor_id must always be set; anonymous audit entries are not permitted

domainEvents.name: MetricSnapshotRecorded
domainEvents.trigger: A RevenueSnapshot or CustomerGrowthSnapshot is added to a CompanyMetric via the MetricAggregate

payload.description: Unique event identifier.
Timestamp when the snapshot was recorded.
ID of the root CompanyMetric (same as metric_id).
ID of the CompanyMetric this snapshot belongs to.
ID of the newly recorded snapshot.
MetricType value indicating snapshot subtype ('revenue' or 'customer_growth').
Start of the reporting period covered by this snapshot.
End of the reporting period covered by this snapshot.

domainEvents.name: AlertTriggered
domainEvents.trigger: AlertRule.evaluate() determines the threshold condition is satisfied by the current metric value

payload.description: Unique event identifier.
Timestamp when the threshold was crossed.
ID of the AlertRule aggregate root (same as rule_id).
ID of the newly created DashboardAlert.
ID of the AlertRule that fired.
ID of the CompanyMetric whose value triggered the alert.
The metric value that crossed the threshold.
The configured threshold value from the AlertRule.
ThresholdOperator string value used in the comparison.
AlertSeverity string value assigned to the triggered alert.

domainEvents.name: AlertAcknowledged
domainEvents.trigger: DashboardAlert.acknowledge() transitions status from ACTIVE to ACKNOWLEDGED

payload.description: Unique event identifier.
Timestamp of the acknowledgement.
ID of the AlertRule aggregate root.
ID of the acknowledged DashboardAlert.
ID of the AlertRule that produced this alert.
User ID of the staff member who acknowledged the alert.

domainEvents.name: AlertResolved
domainEvents.trigger: DashboardAlert.resolve() transitions status to RESOLVED (from ACTIVE or ACKNOWLEDGED)

payload.description: Unique event identifier.
Timestamp of the resolution.
ID of the AlertRule aggregate root.
ID of the resolved DashboardAlert.
ID of the AlertRule that produced this alert.
User ID of the staff member who resolved the alert.

domainEvents.name: AlertRulePaused
domainEvents.trigger: AlertRule.pause() transitions status from ACTIVE to PAUSED

payload.description: Unique event identifier.
Timestamp when the rule was paused.
ID of the AlertRule aggregate root (same as rule_id).
ID of the paused AlertRule.
User ID of the staff member who paused the rule.

domainEvents.name: AlertRuleActivated
domainEvents.trigger: AlertRule.activate() transitions status from PAUSED to ACTIVE

payload.description: Unique event identifier.
Timestamp when the rule was reactivated.
ID of the AlertRule aggregate root (same as rule_id).
ID of the reactivated AlertRule.
User ID of the staff member who reactivated the rule.

domainEvents.name: MetricImportCompleted
domainEvents.trigger: A CSV ImportJob finishes processing all rows without a fatal error

payload.description: Unique event identifier.
Timestamp when the import job completed.
ID of the CompanyMetric targeted by this import (same as metric_id).
Identifier of the background ImportJob.
ID of the CompanyMetric populated by this import.
Number of CSV rows successfully persisted as snapshots.
Number of CSV rows skipped due to validation errors.

domainEvents.name: MetricImportFailed
domainEvents.trigger: A CSV ImportJob terminates with a fatal error before all rows are processed

payload.description: Unique event identifier.
Timestamp when the failure was detected.
ID of the CompanyMetric targeted by this import (same as metric_id).
Identifier of the failed background ImportJob.
ID of the CompanyMetric targeted by this import.
Human-readable description of the fatal error that terminated the job.

domainServices.name: AlertEvaluationService
domainServices.responsibility: Evaluates all active AlertRules against the most recent metric snapshots and creates DashboardAlerts for any threshold crossings. Spans MetricAggregate (read) and AlertAggregate (write). Contains no Django, Q2, or infrastructure references; pure domain logic.

methods.name: evaluate_all_rules
methods.description: Iterates all ACTIVE AlertRules via AlertRuleRepository, fetches the most recent snapshot value for each rule's metric_id via MetricRepository, applies the threshold condition, creates a DashboardAlert via the rule when the condition is met, persists it via DashboardAlertRepository, and returns the list of AlertTriggered events raised.

domainServices.name: MetricAggregationService
domainServices.responsibility: Computes period-over-period PeriodDeltas and rolling averages for a CompanyMetric over a DateRange. Modeled as a domain service because these aggregation computations span multiple snapshots and have no natural home on a single entity. Its results feed AlertEvaluationService and the dashboard KPI use cases.

methods.name: compute_period_delta
methods.description: Fetches snapshots via MetricRepository for the current DateRange and the prior DateRange for the given metric_id, sums their values, and returns a PeriodDelta containing the absolute change and percentage change (None when prior total is zero).

methods.name: compute_rolling_average
methods.description: Fetches all snapshots within the DateRange for the given metric_id via MetricRepository, applies a sliding window of window_days days across the series, and returns the mean as a Decimal.
